name: Mystic Studio
author: TBIT DESIGN - Thomas Breher
description: Birth data becomes a finished poster in the shape of your document, computed entirely on your device. Pick a card - a real natal chart wheel with houses and aspects, the Big Three, element balance, a cosmic profile, the moon over any night (single, cycle or week), zodiac and Chinese zodiac posters, life path, personal year, name chart, angel numbers, couple and synastry charts - then a look: curated styles from midnight gold to rose quartz, or Surprise me. Backdrops (night sky, nebula, aurora, dusk, paper), star density, frames from a fine line to zodiac and celestial borders, layouts that adapt to portrait, square and landscape, your own colors, fonts, a foil title and a personal message. Titles, dates, keywords and meanings land as editable text layers, grouped with the background and the art. Reopen the poster via Edit Mystic Studio: it updates in place and keeps the text you changed by hand.
